validation_environment: Arena.ai sandbox; direct Python httpx/curl outbound HTTPS returned TLS EOF for tested external sources, while Arena fetch_page could retrieve public pages. Runtime source adapters are therefore unit/fixture-tested here and public pages are content-validated with fetch_page.

tested_sources.evidence: ACBAR jobs page showed 270 jobs and current Afghanistan vacancies including 145902 Medical Doctor (MD).
tested_sources.limitations: Python httpx and curl in this sandbox failed with TLS EOF; adapter remains failure-isolated.

tested_sources.evidence: UNJobs page showed 43 Afghanistan vacancies, including Nurse (UNAMA Kabul), Medical Doctor (UNAMA Mazar-i-Sharif), Medical Doctor (UNAMA Gardez), Laboratory Technologist, and UNICEF Polio/Health-related postings.

Nurse, Kabul — UNAMA — https://unjobs.org/vacancies/1790589742575 (public listing says no specified closing date; verify current status on official route)
Medical Doctor (MD) / Team leader, Herat — CTG — https://unjobs.org/vacancies/1790434848677 (observed but already closed on 2026-09-29)

tested_sources.evidence: UNICEF official page showed current Afghanistan vacancies, including INTERNATIONALS ONLY - Information Management Consultant, Polio Section, Afghanistan, deadline 04 Oct 2026, with official PageUp apply URL.
